description: Reference facts for paying and reading on Base mainnet: chain id, native USDC contract and decimals, block explorer and public RPC URLs, and the x402 network identifier. Use to configure an x402 or Base client. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
